title: T12.spec.ts:1242, the test that failed gate G6, cannot tell a regression from noise: it times T12's own hydration, about 35 to 65 ms at full speed for any link that changes the state, its control included, in G5 and G6 alike
location: site/tests/e2e/T12.spec.ts:1207-1238 (hydrationTask returns 0 for a task under 50 ms) and :1241-1255 (median of three; limit max(50, control + 15)); site/src/components/tools/T12RepresentationBuilder.svelte:742-763 (readLink and load(state) run inside the hydration $effect)
claim: The case (C8 node 7) and the control (E7 node 7, 56 positions) hydrate in tasks of the same length: Svelte's hydration of the server markup plus the re-render to the link's state, with 14 to 20 ms of engine facts. Those tasks straddle 50 ms on this container. Because the test maps every task under 50 ms to 0, the control's median usually collapses to 0 while the case's lands on 51 to 64 at random. Phase 6 added nothing measurable to the task.
expected: The test's stated purpose (from P5-RT-07-01): a link to a large orbit must not hydrate in a longer task than a small one. SPEC 7.6: 'No engine call on the main thread may become a long task (50 ms)'. A regression test should fail only when the behaviour regresses.
observed: True task lengths from traces, 5 runs alternated G5 (6cd2c06) against G6 (f07eec6), RATE=1, medians in ms. At load 23 to 26: C8:7 G5 76.6 [141, 54.3, 52.8, 116.4, 76.6], G6 51.3 [46.1, 127.1, 110.9, 51.3, 39.3]; E7:7 control G5 49.3, G6 42.5; no link G5 28.0, G6 25.5. At load 11 to 15: C8:7 G5 41.5, G6 53.4; E7:7 G5 65.3, G6 51.3; no link G5 34.7, G6 33.3. Module evaluation inside the task is 1 to 4 ms in both builds. Profile (source maps, 1x): Svelte runtime 59 to 62 ms inclusive of a 66 to 70 ms task (with the profiler running); engine self 13.6 to 19.9 ms (startRepresentation, minusculeNodes, orbitSize, classify of C8). No minusculeMatrices or signedMoves run, so the P5 fix holds. The phase 5 reproducer, longtask-based: control E7:7 median 55 [50, 55, 70] at load 24 and 53 [0, 53, 116] at load 15; C8:7 64 and 0. The P5 confirmation already recorded the C8 case as marginal at G5 ('medians 52 and 54 in some runs; the remaining 50 to 55 ms is the island's own Svelte hydration').
reproduction: git worktree add <scratch>/g5 6cd2c06; npm --prefix <scratch>/g5 ci --prefer-offline; npm --prefix <scratch>/g5 run build; npm ci --prefer-offline; npm run build; then PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=<pw> RATE=1 RUNS=5 node redteam/redteam-RT-07-p6-hydration-ab.mjs <scratch>/g5/site/dist site/dist 5572 5573 '/tools/rep/?g=C8&k=7' '/tools/rep/?g=E7&k=7' '/tools/rep/'. Then PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=<pw> RATE=1 RUNS=3 node redteam/redteam-RT-07-p6-t12-link-task.mjs site/dist 5572 E7:7 C8:7 (the control is as long as the case).
specRef: SPEC.md 7.6 'Main-thread work'; site/tests/e2e/T12.spec.ts regression P5-RT-07-01; reports/gate-G6.md section 12; build-plan/reports/orchestrator/round-p5/fixout/confirm-t12-perf.json
proposedFix: Either measure what the test means: time the engine calls inside the hydration task (a performance.measure around readLink and the T12Tool construction, or a CPU profile), or compare true task lengths from a trace for case and control. Or change the product: run load(state) for a link in a task after hydration, so that the hydration task holds only the server markup (about 25 to 35 ms) and the link's re-render gets a task of its own.

title: T5 writes long numbers in full in the tape, the sorted tapes and the end positions of 'Two games compared'

claim: T5 shortens a long value only on the nodes, the tally bars, the products D and M and the dimension; its listText, tuple and cells helpers never call shortValue, so a fired number or an end position of more than 12 digits is written out in full.
expected: SPEC 4.0 'Long numbers': a value of more than 12 digits is shown shortened ('1.2345... x 10^19 (20 digits)'), with the exact digits in the table view, the tooltip and every export. observed: Load /tools/numbers/?g=A2&c=n&s=12345678901234567890,-1, a valid link (SPEC 6.6 allows 40 digits). Node 1 shows shortened, with data-value 12345678901234567890.
